description: Tracking aids the family can name on the shared profile (trackingAids), with the form's label and the search card's line for each, in card order. For the cards only: never sent to a model. The ids must equal the choices in subject-profile.schema.json.

aids.label: Enrolled in Project Lifesaver
aids.line: Enrolled in Project Lifesaver: ask the county team to bring receivers.

aids.label: Wears a MedicAlert ID
aids.line: Wears a MedicAlert or other medical ID: check wrists and neck when found.

aids.label: Carries a GPS tracker
aids.line: Carries a GPS tracker: ask the family for its last location.

aids.label: Phone location is shared
aids.line: Phone location may be shared: command can ask the family for its last location.

noneLine: No tracker or medical ID, as the family said.
